title: The Dip as the skeleton
technique: The Dip's own cuts and camera moves, as a grey blockout video, drive the whole film.
story: A swimwear store owner gets a refund in a slow week.
She builds a 30% discount and is about to hit Save.
Scout, a lime orb, flies to one of her shoppers and asks what stopped her.
The shopper says: "You run a discount every week. I'm just waiting."
Shocked, the owner deletes the discount.
Later that week a full-price order arrives. "Full price. Glad I asked."

shots.what: Macro of her phone, refund slides in, fast pull back
shots.speaker: Owner

shots.what: Medium front, she looks into the lens
shots.line: Sales are so low this week.
shots.speaker: Owner

shots.what: Slow push in until her dashboard fills the frame, sales sliding
Five flash cuts: typing, discount page, slider to 30%, Save
She sits back, lips closed; Scout lifts off her phone
shots.line: Maybe it's time for a discount.
shots.speaker: Owner (inner)

shots.what: Time stops; Scout flies out the window to the shopper's bedroom
shots.line: Not yet. There's something you don't know.
shots.speaker: Scout

shots.what: She taps an AirPod; the call card rises off her phone
shots.line: Sunset bikini, three times in your cart. What stopped you?
shots.speaker: Scout

shots.what: Over her shoulder, the card floats; she answers
shots.line: You run a discount every week. I'm just waiting.
shots.speaker: Shopper

shots.what: Back in the studio, card beside her laptop; time restarts
Whip pan: she freezes holding the coral swimsuit, eyes wide
shots.line: Oh my god... I'm training them to wait.
shots.speaker: Owner

shots.what: From behind at the laptop: clicks Delete, "Discount deleted" toast
shots.line: You know what? Let's delete all these discounts.
shots.speaker: Owner

shots.what: Later that week: full-price order on her phone; she smiles
shots.speaker: Owner

shots.what: The end screen: Scout's talking "o" wordmark
shots.line: Scout interviews your shoppers for you. Get free early access.
shots.speaker: Scout
